description: This PHP source file defines the ClientRepository class implementing OAuth2 client management functions, including retrieving client entities and validating clients, within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 module.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 client repository interface for retrieving and validating OAuth2 clients within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a client entity based on client identifier, returning null if not found.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates client credentials and grant type, returning true if valid, false or null otherwise.
